title: 第670章 什么情况这不对吧第669章 我丢不起那个人懂吧
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: 苏业带着温青青和柳茜茜直接回到了帝都大学的别墅。
温青青脸上带着笑容的直接离开了。
苏业坐在沙发上看着有些发呆的柳茜茜。
“发什么呆？”苏业看向柳茜茜笑着说道，点了一支蕴魂草，看向柳茜茜眼中带着一丝笑意。
柳茜茜深吸了一口气看向苏业，随后主动的褪去了身上的衣服，就这么站在苏业面前，身躯有些不自觉的发抖。
苏业看向柳茜茜，眼中带着一丝赞赏，不得不说柳茜茜没有她表面上看上去那么柔弱。
更没有哭哭啼啼的求自己放过她，显然她早就做好了一切的心理准备。
“啧啧，你这样，我还真不忍心下手了。”苏业笑着说道，拿出柳茜茜的卖身契约，放到了柳茜茜的面前。
“给你两个选择，一个，以后跟着我，另外一个带着这个契约离开，你自己选。”苏业带着一丝慵懒的说道，俊美的脸上带着笑容，眸子灿若星辰。
柳茜茜看着苏业放在自己面前的卖身契约一愣。
她想过很多，但是唯独没有想过这样的事情发生。
第一个很好理解，跟着苏业，那就是苏业的人了，第二个带着契约离开，那自己就是自由人了，不再受到任何的约束。
也不会在有今天的事情发生。
这对于柳茜茜来说是天大的好事情。
但是离开真的是好事情吗？
柳茜茜看着面前的契约，迟疑了，自由？
对于普通人来说那是奢侈品，哪怕是她也是一样，哪有什么绝对的自由，只有相对意义上的自由。
这已经是大多数人可望而不及的存在了。
自己带着契约离开能做什么呢？
傅伟他们知道了，会怎么做？有的时候，长得太漂亮了本身就是一种罪。
柳茜茜很清楚，没有人关照她，她的下场会是什么样子？她比谁都清楚。
那些圈子里面风光无限的明星，无论男女，有几个有好下场的，说白了就是人家的玩物而已。
戏子终究是下九流，艺术家是艺术家，搞清楚，这不是一个概念的存在。
“路是自己选择的，我这个人不喜欢强迫人，尤其是女人。”苏业笑着说到看向柳茜茜。
柳茜茜沉默了，看着面前的契约，随后动了，将契约放到了苏业的手上。
“我选择一，跟着你！！”柳茜茜看向苏业沉声的说道。
既然苏业能够做出让自己选择的事情，那么就绝对不会将自己送人这种事情发生。
被一个人，还是被一群人，这个柳茜茜比谁都清楚明白。
苏业看向柳茜茜，没有丝毫意外，他知道柳茜茜是聪明人，这么选择也没有什么意外。
柳茜茜这么选择也不是没脑子的就这么选择了苏业。
首先傅伟都要讨好的人，这就足够了，其次苏业比自己还小，到底谁亏谁赚，还真说不一定。
最重要的是，趁着苏业和傅伟聊天的时候，柳茜茜也查了查苏业的资料，这才知道，苏业是帝国的新贵。
就连那些大家族都要头疼的人物，跟着他，最起码没人敢打自己的主意了。
除非是想要得罪苏业。
她又不傻，自己一个人离开的话，最后会发生什么，难说。
“行吧，既然如此，你打算以后做什么？继续当明星？”苏业看向柳茜茜有些好奇的说道。
听到苏业的话，柳茜茜看向苏业：“我准备开一个娱乐公司。”
“嗯？可以，没问题，有什么问题跟我说。”苏业想着柳茜茜说道。
柳茜茜哪怕什么都不做都行，对于自己的女人，苏业不会亏待的，就当养一个提供情绪价值的花瓶了。
情绪价值拉满也不是不可以。
content_en:
Su Ye took Wen Qingqing and Liu Qianqian directly back to the villa at Imperial University.
Wen Qingqing left directly with a smile on her face.
Su ye sat on the sofa and looked at Liu Qianqian, who was in a daze.
"Why are you in a daze?" Su Ye looked at Liu Qianqian and said with a smile. He lit a piece of soul-accumulating grass and looked at Liu Qianqian with a smile in his eyes.
Liu Qianqian took a deep breath and looked at Su ye, then took off her clothes on her own initiative, and stood in front of Su ye, her body trembling unconsciously.
Su Ye looked at Liu Qianqian with a hint of admiration in his eyes. It had to be said that Liu Qianqian was not as weak as she looked on the surface.
She didn't even cry and beg herself to let her go. It was obvious that she had been mentally prepared for everything.
"Tsk, tsk, if you act like this, I really can't bear to do anything." Su Ye said with a smile, took out Liu Qianqian's selling contract and placed it in front of Liu Qianqian.
"I'll give you two choices. One is to follow me from now on, and the other is to leave with this contract. It's your choice." Su ye said lazily, with a smile on his handsome face and eyes as bright as stars.
Liu Qianqian was stunned when she looked at the prostitution contract that Su Ye placed in front of her.
She thought about it a lot, but she never thought about such a thing happening.
The first one is easy to understand. If you follow Su ye, you will be Su ye's person. The second one will leave with the contract, then you will be a free man and no longer subject to any restrictions.
What happened today will never happen again.
This is a great thing for Liu Qianqian.
But is leaving really a good thing?
Liu Qianqian looked at the contract in front of her and hesitated, freedom?
For ordinary people, it was a luxury, even for her. There was no absolute freedom, only freedom in a relative sense.
This is already beyond the reach of most people.
What can I do if I leave with the contract?
What will Fu Wei and the others do if they find out? Sometimes, being too beautiful is a sin in itself.
Liu Qianqian knew very well that if no one took care of her, what would happen to her? She knows it better than anyone else.
Among those celebrities who are extremely famous in the industry, regardless of whether they are men or women, some of them have ended up well. To put it bluntly, they are just other people's playthings.
After all, actors are just inferior, and artists are artists. Please understand that this is not a concept.
"You choose your own path. I don't like forcing people, especially women." Su Ye said with a smile and looked at Liu Qianqian.
Liu Qianqian was silent, looking at the contract in front of her, then moved and placed the contract in Su Ye's hand.
"I choose one, follow you!!" Liu Qianqian looked at Su Ye and said in a deep voice.
Since Su ye can do things that let him choose, then he will never give himself away.
Whether by one person or by a group of people, Liu Qianqian knows it better than anyone else.
Su Ye looked at Liu Qianqian without any surprise. He knew that Liu Qianqian was a smart person, so there was no surprise in her choice.
Liu Qianqian didn't choose Su Ye without thinking.
First of all, Fu Wei wanted to please people, and that was enough. Secondly, Su Ye was younger than him, so it was hard to say who would lose and who would gain.
The most important thing is that while Su ye and Fu Wei were chatting, Liu Qianqian also checked Su ye's information, and then she realized that Su ye was an upstart in the empire.
Even those people who are troublesome to big families, if they follow him, at least no one will dare to take any chances on him.
Unless you want to offend Su ye.
She's not stupid. If she leaves alone, it's hard to say what will happen in the end.
"Okay, in that case, what do you plan to do in the future? Continue to be a star?" Su Ye looked at Liu Qianqian and said curiously.
Hearing Su Ye's words, Liu Qianqian looked at Su ye: "I'm going to open an entertainment company."
"Huh? Okay, no problem. If you have any questions, tell me." Su Ye said, thinking about Liu Qianqian.
Even if Liu Qianqian does nothing, Su ye will not treat his woman badly, just treat her like a vase that provides emotional value.
It is not impossible to maximize the emotional value.
title_en: Chapter 670: What's going on? Isn't this wrong? Chapter 669: I can't afford to lose that person, understand?
